page_title: LEC 0-3 COM | Lecce v Como 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) produces a mid-range free kick, but fails to find the target. He curled the ball over the wall but his shot goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
90+4' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) is punished with the yellow card.
90+1' 0 - 3 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Assane Diao (Como) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

84' 0 - 2 Perfectly taken free kick! Lucas Da Cunha sends a cross in and Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes into the top left corner and the score changes to 0:2.
83' Medon Berisha (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Nico Paz will be replaced by Maxence Caqueret (Como).
82' A substitution has been made. Anastasios Douvikas is replaced by Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Maximo Perrone as he is replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).
79' Substitution. Ylber Ramadani makes way for Ante Rebic (Lecce).
77' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' The ball possession at the moment is 42:58.
74' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
73' Maximo Perrone (Como) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
72' Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
68' That's the end of the game for Jonathan Ikone, who is replaced by Gabriel Strefezza (Como).
68' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Tete Morente is replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
63' Lecce will take a corner kick.

63' Tete Morente (Lecce) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top left corner is blocked by Jean Butez, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
60' The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thorir Johann Helgason walks off the pitch to be replaced by Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).
54' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Konan Ndri (Lecce) replacing Santiago Pierotti.
53' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement.
52' A pass by Medon Berisha (Lecce) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
50' That's a well-taken pass by Anastasios Douvikas (Como). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
50' The ball is cleared after Tete Morente (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Como hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Giampaolo probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lassana Coulibaly. He is replaced by Medon Berisha (Lecce).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' A yellow card for bad language! Jonathan Ikone (Como) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
45+4' The referee can't ignore those comments and Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) sees a yellow card for bad language.
45+3' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) swings in a cross from the corner, but Jean Butez reads it well and gathers the ball.
45+2' Tete Morente (Lecce) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
45+1' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alex Valle (Como) suffers an injury and Alberto Moreno comes on.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Alex Valle (Como) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Alex Valle (Como) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
41' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
41' Como are seeing far more of the ball now.

40' A great solo effort from Tete Morente (Lecce) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot low towards the middle of the goal. Jean Butez has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
35' Wait! Referee Simone Sozza has indicated he is going to review the Como goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
33' 0 - 1 Goal! Nico Paz shows great vision to find Assane Diao (Como) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

32' Jonathan Ikone plays a short pass through to Anastasios Douvikas (Como) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
32' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
30' Maximo Perrone (Como) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
30' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is about to take a corner kick.
28' Maximo Perrone (Como) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simone Sozza blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
27' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lecce.
26' Lecce force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
25' Tete Morente (Lecce) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
24' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
23' Wladimiro Falcone displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Nico Paz (Como) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
23' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
21' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
19' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
18' Jean Butez (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
17' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
17' Tete Morente (Lecce) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
16' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
15' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
13' Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a great save to deny Anastasios Douvikas (Como), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
13' A player from Lecce commits a rough challenge. Simone Sozza blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
13' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) has proven his good peripheral vision as he picks out Anastasios Douvikas with a lovely through ball.
11' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) makes a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from Lecce won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Como earn a free kick.
7' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
6' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has a goal ruled out for offside!
5' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Nico Paz (Como).
4' Como are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Assane Diao (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

2' A pass travels right across the box to Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez denies him with a decent save.
1' Como control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Como will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza was nominated as the referee for this game.
